name: Lantern
note: DEMO PLAN. Invented. A small grocery-delivery app, written so an audience can read it cold: products are things a customer would name, features are parts of those things, steps are the work.

products.name: Shop Front
products.note: What the customer sees when they arrive: the shelves, the search box, the pictures.

features.name: Product search
features.note: Type a word, get the things that match.

features.name: Photo gallery
features.note: Every item shows more than one picture.

features.name: Stock levels
features.note: Says what is actually on the shelf right now.

features.name: Save for later
features.note: Put something aside without buying it yet.

products.name: Checkout
products.note: Taking the money, and telling the customer it worked.

features.name: Card payment
features.note: Take a card and confirm the money moved.

features.name: Discount codes
features.note: Type a code, watch the price drop.

features.name: Delivery slot picker
features.note: Choose the hour the food arrives.

features.name: Receipt email
features.note: A confirmation lands in the inbox.

products.name: Delivery Tracker
products.note: Where the order is, right now.

features.name: Live map
features.note: A moving dot on a map of the street.

features.name: Arrival estimate
features.note: How many minutes until the door.

features.name: Text message updates
features.note: A message when the driver sets off.

products.name: Customer Account
products.note: Who the customer is, and what they told us before.

features.name: Sign in
features.note: Get back into your own account.

features.name: Saved addresses
features.note: Do not retype your street every time.

features.name: Past orders
features.note: See what you bought last week.

steps.title: Draw the search box
Connect the search box to the product list
Say something useful when nothing matches
Let the customer swipe between photos

Read the shelf count from the warehouse
Grey out anything that has sold out
Add the save-for-later button
Show the saved things on their own page
Build the card form
Take the payment and wait for the answer
Handle a card that gets declined
Add the discount code box
Check the code is real before dropping the price
Show the free delivery hours as a grid
Hold the chosen hour so nobody else takes it
Send the receipt email
Put the actual items on the receipt
Draw the map
Move the driver's dot as they drive
Work out the minutes to the door
Slow the estimate down when the road is busy
Send a message when the driver sets off
Let the customer turn the messages off

phases.title: Give them a key to the door

steps.title: Build the sign-in form
Let a forgotten password be reset
Remember an address after the first order
Let the customer pick between saved addresses
List the past orders newest first
Add a buy-it-again button
